description: Canada visit visa from Pakistan (Canada): requirements, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, common mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: Canada visit visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: IRCC application, funds, purpose, ties, biometrics. SK prepares from PKR 30,000.

faqs.question: Do I need an invitation for Canada?
faqs.answer: Strongly recommended for family visits; include host status and financial details.

faqs.question: Canada visitor visa processing time?
faqs.answer: Varies by IRCC workload — often weeks to months. We prepare complete files to avoid avoidable delays.

faqs.question: Can I work on Canada visitor visa?
faqs.answer: No. Work needs a work permit.

faqs.question: Super visa vs visitor?
faqs.answer: Super Visa is a parents/grandparents category with insurance and income rules. Different from standard TRV.

Canada visit visa from Pakistan — TRV visitor records and family visits

Canada visitor visas (Temporary Resident Visa) from Pakistan require online IRCC applications, biometrics and strong ties to Pakistan. Officers assess temporary intent — not just bank balance.

Where Pakistanis apply (Canada)

After IRCC approval instructions, biometrics and passport submission use VFS Global Canada in Pakistan.

Centres: Islamabad · Karachi · Lahore (verify VFS Canada Pakistan). Confirm the live centre list before paying travel costs to a VAC city.

Tourism visits

Tourism needs credible itinerary, funds and employment; prior US/UK travel helps but does not replace ties.

Family visits

Super visa and family visit streams have different rules — confirm category before applying.

Business visitor (short meetings)

Business visitor letters from Canadian and Pakistani companies with meeting scope.

Pakistan-side refusal risks

  • TRV filed with hidden study/work intent
  • Weak employment proof for young applicants
  • Prior refusals not explained
  • Biometrics deadline missed

Funds and credibility

Funds must cover trip and show income history; borrowed lumps fail credibility checks.

Visit vs study / work

Short visits cannot replace student residence or work permits. For degrees see Canada study visa. Work needs correct authorization — work permit hub.

Official Canada links · Canada visit checklist · refusal reasons · appointment guides

Cover letter outline (Canada visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for Canada cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
